name: VisDoMBench
description: VisDoMBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate question answering systems in multi-document settings with rich multimodal content, including tables, charts, and presentation slides. It measures the ability of models to perform multimodal document-grounded QA by integrating visual and textual information.
reputation: A specialized multimodal document QA benchmark with limited but growing use in document-understanding research.
notes: Focuses on multi-document QA with visually rich elements and multimodal retrieval-augmented generation.
